name: Lupusburg
summary: Social deduction where one hidden Werewolf kills by night, townsfolk bet on and lynch suspects, points decide winner if Werewolf dies.
rules_text: Each player owns two houses, one hides his chest, and two facedown characters: 1 Werewolf, 1 Thief, rest Townsfolk dealt per player count. If one player gets Werewolf+Thief reshuffle. Characters are placed under houses, Werewolf/Thief cannot go under chest house. Night: all eyes closed tapping. Burgomaster calls Thief, who silently lifts any house to check for chest. Then Burgomaster calls Werewolf, who points central claw at a house to kill that character, may self-kill if he has two alive. Day: killed house and character are removed facedown. Burgomaster may privately look at one living character, then show one of his own to that owner. Then clockwise each player may bet: draw 3 coins from bag, choose 1, place facedown with his seal before a player suspected to be Werewolf. Then players debate and vote to lynch one living character, removing its house. Repeat nights/days until Werewolf character is lynched or all non-Werewolf characters are dead. If Werewolf slaughters all, he wins alone. Otherwise points: 2 per living character, 1 if your chest house survived, face value of correctly bet coin, 1 for unused seal. Highest points wins.
rating_reason: Werewolf-style hidden roles with bluffing and deduction.
